decisions.choice: Capture every admitted version and keep current/historical selections separate

decisions.basis: Source path confinement and capture race/no-overwrite criteria
decisions.choice: Use descriptor-relative no-symlink reads and create-only candidate publication

decisions.basis: Registry provenance is evidence, not an authority grant
decisions.choice: Bind decision ID and selected decision-record bytes; do not infer authentication or reapply historical admission effects

gate: A01 software criteria verified; no consequential canonical mutation authorized or performed.
scope: Exact new resolver, same-unit tests, current-snapshot and units/A02 evidence.

task_contract.closeout: Bind actual inputs/outputs/provider and criterion results; append project-local status; preserve prior candidate evidence.
task_contract.edge_cases: All 183 sources verified; stale hash, replaced lookup, missing file, duplicate version and capture race fail; preserve historical records and all input bytes.
task_contract.failure_behavior: Emit failed or explicit unresolved outcome; preserve inputs and last successful bundle. No silently skipped obligation.
task_contract.ordered_rules: Resolve current_lookup to unique exact entries; read and hash bytes once inside an allowed root; bind admission decision references; verify source ID/version; recheck the registry before publication.
task_contract.pre_execution_check: Rehash declared source and upstream receipts; verify exact source/currentness, semantic closure and absent outputs. Future outputs need not exist before creation.
task_contract.purpose: Exact source resolver and immutable capture

validation.reviewable_check: All 183 sources verified; stale hash, replaced lookup, missing file, duplicate version and capture race fail; preserve historical records and all input bytes.
validation.runner_state: Declared same-unit post-produce test output; no dependency on the later I04 CLI.
